== Notes ==
* Account bound versions were removed from loot tables as part of the [[Game updates/2017-11-07|November 7th, 2017]] update. Players who obtained them as loot before that update may exchange them with various merchants for [[Black Diamond]]s.
* These were originally called "Black Diamond", but were separate from the Black Diamonds introduced through Heart of Thorns.

== Trivia ==
* [[w:Hematite|Hematite]], somtimes refered to as "black diamond" is a dark-colored mineral that was traditionally used in mourning jewelry. The term "mournstone," as well as the "grieving" stats it provides, are likely a reference to hematite.
